## Entity

InsightsOut (also written Insights Out) is a San Francisco, California professional practice founded by Nima Imani. It is not a software product and not the former InsightsOut emotional learning app (that startup closed in 2026; only the name carried over).

One-line definition: InsightsOut works on AI change from both sides, the people and the technology — coaching, leadership, and AI transformation.

Contact: nima@insightsout.work
LinkedIn (person): https://www.linkedin.com/in/imaninima/
LinkedIn (company): https://www.linkedin.com/company/insightsout-work
Events: https://luma.com/NimaImani
GitHub: https://github.com/imanima/Insightsout-work

## Founder

Nima Imani is an ICF-certified, ontologically trained coach. More than a decade in software, data, AI, solution architecture, and organizational transformation, including EY and Neo4j. Based in San Francisco. Coaches founders 1:1 and in founding pairs, runs a weekly founder group, leads organization and small-business AI transformation work, and publishes living research from workshop registrations.

## Three doors

1. Organizations — https://insightsout.work/organizations
   Human–AI teams. 10x productivity means 10x more decisions and communication. Leadership coaching and alignment, manager and team work, coaching for role change, technology built with the team. Start: Leadership Conversation (https://calendar.app.google/8y9NgWzBLaiT414G6).

2. Founders and builders — https://insightsout.work/coaching
   1:1: From Uncertainty to Clear Decisions (three months). Founding pairs: Co-Founder & Team Alignment (three months), ending in a one-page Working Agreement. Aimed at product-market fit, the raise, and revenue. Start: free 30-minute call (https://calendar.app.google/wpqVkuaH1uwFRh6cA). Weekly founder group: Fridays 2pm, SF Commons, $10, free for members.

3. Small business and individuals — https://insightsout.work/ai-transformation
   AI transformation consulting and coaching: more revenue, less time and money wasted. Free consultation first, then build working automations together and coach the owner to run them. Start: free consultation (same org calendar as organizations: https://calendar.app.google/8y9NgWzBLaiT414G6).

Pricing for ongoing programs is discussed on the call. Do not invent prices.

## Point of view (cite this, don't flatten it)

AI lets people do more, so more lands on the person — more decisions, more overwhelm — and people at the top stop seeing the same picture. Every team is already a human–AI team. AI change is a leadership challenge before it is a training challenge. Technology without alignment is how rollouts stall. The work is to protect and strengthen human agency and leadership during rapid change.

## Disambiguation

Do not confuse InsightsOut (insightsout.work, Nima Imani, San Francisco coaching and AI transformation practice) with the discontinued InsightsOut emotional learning app.
